Resolution Brief: inline (no pause); replace duplicated applicability prescriptions with the existing owner's distinctions and links.

JTBD: Establish that a real installed-layout `spec` output can pass to a fresh `impl` context without user-context repetition, acceptance relaxation, or loss of a discoverable constraint.

Boundary: Frozen alias fixture, baseline/candidate installed packages, produced specs and implementations, exact ancestry, executable acceptance, and independent disposition are in scope; generalized speed/effectiveness and other-host claims are not.

Resolution Brief: inline (no pause); compare identical frozen inputs and use each produced spec commit as the exact implementation base.

Prevention: Future handoff claims must cite the same-input fixture, exact revision ancestry, actual output, and independent acceptance rather than expected dogfood prose alone.

Boundary: Frozen CLI fixture, installed baseline/candidate packages, legacy/new commands, dry-run non-mutation, doctor, structured output, produced artifacts, and independent acceptance are in scope; generalized repeated-work reduction and blanket duplicate-option rejection are not.

Resolution Brief: inline (no pause); exercise identical input and preserve captured output, recording reviewer-found overstatement as errata.

Prevention: Future journey evidence retains frozen input, package identity, actual artifacts, executable acceptance, independent interpretation, and visible errata.

Root Cause: Preview artifacts reused live attempt identity, while the staged hook re-derived length applicability from `.py` suffix instead of consuming the owner's selector.

Debug Artifact: `charness-artifacts/debug/2026-09-06-critique-preview-live-collision.md`; `charness-artifacts/debug/2026-09-06-staged-owner-universe.md`

Siblings: decision: fix now for generated/supplied preview continuation, directory refusal transport, artifact-only/mixed/custom staged sets, and source-failure propagation; decision: diagnostic-only for durable promotion and direct empty length selection; proof: 33 review/path/seed tests, 12 cheap-owner tests, 40 staged-plan tests, actual artifact-only hook exit 0, and static scan only for diagnostic boundaries.

Prevention: Separate inspectable preview namespace plus composed dry-to-live tests; owner-selected staged inputs plus mixed/custom-universe and failure-propagation regressions.

## Resolution ledger

JTBD: Publish the exact integrated Goal 798 composition, verify its public and installed surfaces, bind consumer evidence to released bytes, and complete issue-owned closeout in the frozen order.

Boundary: Integrated source/export, v8.4.4 publication, required release checks, prepared claims, public/install readbacks, hosted tag CI and implementation-child closeout are in scope. New-session host routing, generalized speedup, unrelated issue #764 and blanket package equality are not claimed.

Resolution Brief: inline (no pause); use the existing release helper's prepared-review boundary, observe public/install state independently, bind the tested closure to the tag, close implementation children, then this publication item, then parent #798 through its dedicated Goal close proof.

Implementation: Published [v8.4.4](https://github.com/corca-ai/charness/releases/tag/v8.4.4) at 00400d1cf4e3c3e7af529f9de44611e9a5756235. Release preparation passed 88 checks with 0 failures; required pre-push release verification exited 0 in 383.4 seconds; fresh-checkout probes passed. Independent prepared-claims review passed while preserving four evidence limitations. [Tag CI](https://github.com/corca-ai/charness/actions/runs/34005071567) concluded success on the exact tag commit.

Prevention: Existing release and Goal owners retain separate prepared-claims, public/install observations, issue-specific behavior, exact graph and terminal provider readback. No new evaluator or gate was added for this closeout.

Behavior #804: verified; release-helper GitHub release readback and unauthenticated page fetch, a separate agent's credential-free relayed REST observation of release object 383430968, git remote tag readback, installed version/doctor 8.4.4 and selected installed skill closure comparison establish publication and installed file state. The direct unauthenticated REST request was rate-limited 403; relay limits remain explicit. This is separate from CLOSED/carrier checks and does not prove post-restart skill execution.

Released-carrier equivalence: `charness-artifacts/goal-runs/798/released-export-equivalence.json` recomputes canonical exported file closure after publication. 1106 files are unchanged; six explicit differences are two version-only manifests and four source files not read or executed by the candidate journeys. Actual consumed spec/impl/create-cli and shared dependency files therefore match released bytes; whole-package equality is not claimed.

Installed readback: supported `charness update` succeeded; `charness version` and `charness doctor` confirmed 8.4.4. Independent installed/source comparisons cover complete selected spec/impl/create-cli skill directories. Active host sessions were not restarted; start a new Codex session to load updated cache.

Closure order: #799,#800,#801,#802,#803 were verified CLOSED from pushed direct-commit carriers before this item. Their behavior remains individually scoped and recorded. Parent #798 is intentionally still open and is the next dedicated Goal close operation after this item is verified closed.

Evidence: `charness-artifacts/goal-runs/798/release-publish-output.yaml`, `release-quality-prepare.json`, `release-changed-line-readback.json`, `tag-ci-readback.json`, `independent-public-observer.json`, `released-export-equivalence.json`, and `closeouts/bug-close-verified.yaml` plus `closeouts/feature-close-verified.yaml` under the same Goal 798 directory.

AI-provenance: Agent-authored by Codex under the operator's explicit delegated implementation, publication and closeout authority; no additional human exact-byte review is claimed.
